blocks.text: Theory of relativity yeh batati hai ke ek doosre ke nisbat mukhtalif harkat wale observers physical waqiaat ko kaise bayan karte hain. Special theory of relativity sirf inertial (bina acceleration wale) frames ke masail dekhti hai. Ek aur theory, general theory of relativity, un frames ke masail dekhti hai jo ek doosre ke nisbat accelerate kar rahe hon. Special theory do postulates (bunyadi maani hui baaton) par khari hai:

items: Physics ke laws tamam inertial frames mein ek jaise hain (Principle of Relativity).
Khali space (free space) mein light ki speed har observer ke liye ek hi hai, chahe source ya observer kaise bhi chal rahe hon (Principle of Constancy of Light).

blocks.title: Do You Know?
blocks.text: Torch (flashlight) se nikalne wali light ki speed c do observers ek hi naapte hain: ek jo car mein speed v se chal raha hai, aur doosra jo sarak par khara hai.

Pehla postulate yeh baat aam karta hai ke ek doosre ke nisbat uniform velocity se chalne wale frames mein physics ke saare laws ek jaise hain. Agar laws alag hote to observers bata sakte ke kaun ruka hai aur kaun chal raha hai. Magar aisa koi farq mojood nahi; yani absolute (bilkul) uniform motion ka pata lagane ka koi tareeqa nahi.

Doosra postulate yeh tajurbati haqeeqat hai ke khali space mein light ki speed ek universal constant hai, jise c likhte hain (c = 3 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹). Chunke c constant hai, is liye space aur time relative ban jate hain. Misal: agar aap light ki speed ke qareeb uniform velocity se chalti train mein baithe hon aur bazu bhar ke faasle par aaina (mirror) pakrein, to aap ko apna aks (reflection) phir bhi nazar aayega. Wajah: principle of relativity ke mutabiq koi tajurba andar baithe shakhs ke liye train ki constant harkat ka pata nahi laga sakta.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab likhti hai “light ki speed par chalti train”. Koi material cheez, jaise train, kabhi light ki speed tak nahi pohanch sakti, kyun ke c ke qareeb us ka mass be-hadd barhta hai (isi topic ka mass wala formula). Sahi baat: light ki speed ke qareeb uniform velocity se chalti train.

In saada postulates ke nateeje bohat door tak jate hain. In mein ghariyon ka ahista chalna aur chalte frames mein lambai ka chhota hona shamil hai, jaisa ruka hua observer dekhta hai. Special theory ke kuch dilchasp nateeje, hisab mein jaye baghair, yeh hain.
Simultaneity ki relativity

Agar ek observer ko do mukhtalif jagahon ke do waqiaat simultaneous (bilkul ek waqt par) nazar aayein, to pehle observer ke nisbat chalte hue doosre frame ke observer ko aam taur par woh ek waqt par nazar nahi aayenge. Yani do waqiaat ka ek waqt par hona observer ke frame of reference par depend karta hai.

Ek train socho jis ke darwaze light se khulte hain. Light ka switch chhat ke beech mein hai aur dabbe ke beech khara musafir use chalata hai. Train light ki aadhi speed se chal rahi hai jab musafir light jalata hai. Light aage aur peeche barabar speed se ja kar dono darwazon tak ek hi waqt pohanchti hai, is liye musafir dono darwaze ek saath khulte dekhta hai. Magar train ke bahar wala observer pichhla darwaza agle darwaze se pehle khulta dekhta hai, kyun ke pichhla darwaza light ki taraf aa raha hai aur agla darwaza light se door ja raha hai.

blocks.alt: Oopar: dabbe ke beech lamp se roshni dono taraf barabar faasla tay kar ke back door aur front door tak jati hai. Neeche: bahar se dekha gaya wahi dabba v = c/2 se daen chal raha hai; dashed khaaka chamak ke waqt ki jagah hai, aur roshni 'where the light flashed' wali jagah se dono taraf chalti hai, back door qareeb aur front door door hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Oopar: dabbe ke andar lamp beech mein hai, is liye light har darwaze tak barabar faasla tay karti hai aur dono darwaze ek saath khulte hain. Neeche: bahar wala shakhs dabbe ko light ki aadhi speed se aage jate dekhta hai. Us ke liye bhi light ki speed c hi hai. Light ke chalte chalte pichhla darwaza aage barh kar us se milta hai aur agla door hota jata hai, is liye light pehle pichhle darwaze tak pohanchti hai.

blocks.title: Interesting Information
blocks.text: Agar aap aise frame mein hain jo constant velocity se chal raha hai aur aap ko bahar ka koi aur frame nazar nahi aata, to aap ke paas yeh jaanne ka koi tareeqa nahi ke aap chal rahe hain ya ruke hue hain.
Time dilation (waqt ka phailna)
Special theory ke mutabiq time absolute (har jagah ek jaisa) nahi; yeh frame of reference ki harkat par depend karta hai.

Farz karein ek observer inertial frame mein ruka hua hai aur isi frame mein do waqiaat ke darmiyan ka waqt naapta hai; yeh waqt tₒ hai. Ise proper time kehte hain. Agar observer waqiaat wale frame ke nisbat bohat tez (relativistic) velocity v se chal raha ho, ya woh frame observer ke nisbat uniform velocity v se chal raha ho, to observer ko yeh waqt tₒ nahi balke t milega:

√(1 − v²/c²) hamesha 1 se kam hai, is liye t, tₒ se bara hai: yani observer aur waqiaat ke frame ki relative harkat se time phail (dilate) gaya. Yeh hairat-angez nateeja har tarah ke waqt par lagu hai: physical, chemical aur biological. Bohat tez (relativistic) speed par insaani jism ka boorha hona bhi ahista ho jata hai.

Misal: 0.8 c se chalte jahaz mein musafir kitab utha kar kholta hai; musafir ke hisab se is mein ek second lagta hai. Magar jahaz ke bahar khare shakhs ke hisab se isi kaam mein 1.7 seconds lagte hain (1/√(1 − 0.64) = 1/0.6 ≈ 1.7).
Length contraction (lambai ka chhota hona)

Chalte spaceship mein baithe observer ko zameen se kisi sitare tak ka faasla zameen wale observer ke naape hue faasle se kam lagega. Yani agar aap do aise points ke nisbat chal rahe hain jin ka faasla fixed hai, to yeh faasla us se chhota lagta hai jo ruk kar naapne par milta. Is asar ko length contraction kehte hain. Lambai sirf harkat ki simt mein chhoti hoti hai; harkat ke perpendicular (seedhe zaviye par) koi farq nahi parta. Jo observer cheez ke nisbat ruka hua ho, us ki naapi hui lambai proper length ℓₒ kehlati hai. Agar cheez aur observer ek doosre ke nisbat speed v se chal rahe hon, to chhoti hui lambai ℓ yeh hai:

Ek train ruki hui halat mein 100 metre lambi hai aur light ki speed ke 80% (0.8 c) se chalti hai. Andar wala shakhs us ki lambai 100 metre hi naapega. Magar patri ke kinare khara shakhs train ko sirf 60 metre lamba dekhega (100 × √(1 − 0.64) = 100 × 0.6 = 60). Harkat ki simt mein lambai ka yeh chhota hona length contraction hai.
Mass variation (mass ka badalna)

Special theory ke mutabiq kisi cheez ka mass us ki speed ke saath badalta hai. Ruki hui halat mein naapa gaya mass rest mass mₒ kehlata hai; speed v se chalti dikhe to us ka mass barh kar m ho jata hai:
Mass barhne ka matlab hai ke tez speed par cheez ka inertia barh jata hai. Jaise jaise v, c ke qareeb aati hai, speed badalne ke liye zyada force chahiye hoti hai.

blocks.text_alt: Jab v → c, to v/c → 1, is liye √(1 − v²/c²) → 0

blocks.text: Be-hadd mass ko accelerate karne ke liye be-hadd force chahiye. Aisi force mumkin nahi, is liye koi cheez khali space mein light ki speed c tak accelerate nahi ki ja sakti.

Rozmarra zindagi mein speeds light ki speed ke muqable mein bohat hi kam hain. Zameen ki Suraj ke gird speed bhi sirf 30 km s⁻¹ hai, jab ke light ki speed 300,000 km s⁻¹ hai. Isi liye aam halaat mein Newton ke laws theek kaam karte hain. Magar jab subatomic particles light ki speed ke qareeb chalte hain to relativistic asraat bohat numayan ho jate hain, aur tajurbon ke nateeje Einstein ki equations ke baghair samjhe nahi ja sakte.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Aam speeds par (v/c bohat chhota) dono curves 1 ke qareeb hain, is liye asar mehsoos nahi hota. v = 0.8c par time aur mass 1.67 guna aur lambai 0.6 guna ho jati hai. v jaise jaise c ke qareeb jata hai, laal curve be-hadd oopar jata hai: isi liye koi material cheez light ki speed tak nahi pohanch sakti.

blocks.prompt: Material particle ka light ki speed se chalna namumkin kyun hai? Ek electron 500 m lambi khali tube se 0.995c par guzarta hai; electron ko tube kitni lambi lagti hai? Ausatan 20 min jeene wala neutron 0.8c par chalta hai; zameen se dekhne par woh kitni der zinda rehta hai?
blocks.explanation: Jaise v, c ke qareeb aati hai, m = mₒ/√(1 − v²/c²) be-hadd barhta hai, is liye speed thori si bhi barhane ke liye barhti hui force chahiye; c tak pohanchne ke liye be-hadd force aur energy chahiye. ℓ = 500 m × √(1 − 0.995²) = 500 × 0.0999 ≈ 50 m. t = 20 min/√(1 − 0.64) = 20/0.6 ≈ 33.3 min.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Special relativity inertial frames ki theory hai (accelerating frames: general relativity). Postulates: (1) physics ke laws har inertial frame mein ek jaise; (2) khali space mein light ki speed c = 3 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹ har observer ke liye ek. Nateeja: space aur time relative.

Simultaneity relative hai (light se khulne wale darwazon wali train). Time dilation t = tₒ/√(1 − v²/c²) (11.1); harkat ki simt mein length contraction ℓ = ℓₒ√(1 − v²/c²) (11.2); mass m = mₒ/√(1 − v²/c²) (11.3), is liye koi material cheez c tak nahi pohanchti.
